subject: WellPath: residency surcharge + annual evidence fee — pricing proposal and PO path
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@wellpath.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@wellpath.ai
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Residency surcharge + monthly evidence fee (initial ask)

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks again for the deep dive this morning. A couple of items procurement asked me to confirm quickly so we can move to PO:

1) Residency surcharge — we need one line item that covers EU data residency for our clinical subsets. Procurement expects this to be recurring monthly rather than a one-time activation. Can you confirm the proposed rate for our committed monthly throughput (approx 120M tokens/month)?

2) Annual evidence fee — our security team wants on-demand packaged evidence delivery (SOC2 extracts + HSM attestation) once per year. They don’t want a big upfront implementation fee, but will accept an annual fixed charge. What are your suggested packaging options?

Attached is our most recent vendor security questionnaire and the PO contact. Happy to take a short call next week.

Thanks,
Sara Lim
Head of Platform Security, WellPath
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@wellpath.ai>, procurement@wellpath.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Residency surcharge + monthly evidence fee (initial ask)

Sara — thanks, good questions. High level options below (attached I’ve included an itemized quote so procurement can map to a PO line):

Option A — Recurring residency surcharge (recommended for committed customers) - Monthly surcharge: $7,500 / month (applies while EU residency enabled) - Includes: reserved EU capacity, region routing, standard 30-day data retention for audit logs

Option B — Residency as a usage uplift (blended) - 10% surcharge on monthly usage invoice (token-based) - Good if throughput varies significantly

Evidence delivery (annual) — two packaging choices - Pack 1: Annual evidence bundle — $12,000 / year (SOC2 extracts, HSM attestation summary, on-demand evidence playbook; delivered within 15 business days) - Pack 2: Light evidence subscription — $4,000 / year + $1,200 per ad-hoc evidence export (2 week turnaround)

HSM/KMS seats — for WellPath scale we typically recommend 1 HSM seat + high-throughput key proxy. Seat pricing: $3,000 / seat / month or amortize as $30,000 one-time onboarding for dedicated HSM path.

Recommended default for WellPath (to keep procurement happy and predictable): Option A (monthly residency surcharge) + Pack 1 (annual evidence bundle) + 1 HSM seat (monthly). We can offer a 10% discount on the first 6 months of residency surcharge if they sign a 12-month PO.

Next steps: if procurement prefers amortized onboarding instead of monthly seat, we can convert the seat to a one-time onboarding fee and offset it with a 6-month credit. I’ve attached the detailed line items.

– Karthik Iyer
Director, Commercial Strategy — Redwood Inference
From: procurement@wellpath.ai
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@wellpath.ai>, Kunal Mehta <kunal.mehta@wellpath.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 08:21:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Residency surcharge + monthly evidence fee (initial ask)

Karthik / Laura —

Thanks for the options. A few clarifying points from procurement and finance: 

• Finance will prefer a single recurring line for budgeting. They want the residency delivered as a monthly line item (Option A), but we need the first 12 months to be capped at a blended effective rate no higher than $70k total (we’ll issue a 12-month PO).

• For the evidence bundle: procurement wants the lower-cost Pack 2 but with one complimentary ad-hoc export per year included for regulatory requests (so effectively Pack 2 + 1 export).

• HSM seat: finance prefers the amortized one-time onboarding fee (they will treat it as CapEx) if it reduces monthly run-rate. Can you provide the exact one-time number and proposed amortization credit?

Please respond with a revised line-item quote (single monthly residency line + annual evidence line + one-time HSM onboarding if applicable). If you can get back to us by EOD Wednesday we’ll route for signature.

Procurement (WellPath)
From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: procurement@wellpath.ai, Sara Lim <sara.lim@wellpath.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Residency surcharge + monthly evidence fee (initial ask)

Hi — looping in Ben for invoicing treatment. Quick answers / proposal: 

• Residency (single monthly line): we can set a capped monthly rate of $5,833.33 / month for 12 months to meet your $70k cap (total $70,000). This maps to our Option A with the 10% early-commit discount baked into the first year.

• Evidence bundle: we’ll propose "Pack 2 + 1 export" at $4,000 / year with the first complimentary export included; price line will read $4,000 / year.

• HSM onboarding: one-time onboarding fee = $30,000. Proposed treatment: WellPath pays $30k upfront; Redwood will apply a $5,000 credit against monthly residency charges across the first 6 months (effectively reducing monthly residency by ~$833.33 for months 1–6). If WellPath prefers CapEx accounting, we can invoice the $30k as a single upfront charge and apply the credits as described.

Ben — please confirm invoice wording and whether the $5k credit can be applied in the manner described.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales Operations — Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, procurement@wellpath.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Residency surcharge + monthly evidence fee (initial ask)

Procurement / Laura / Karthik —

Confirmed on invoicing treatment:

• Residency line: "WellPath — EU Residency Surcharge (12-mo capped)" — Monthly amount: $5,833.33 — Invoice monthly starting on term start date. Total cap: $70,000.

• Annual evidence: "WellPath — Evidence Subscription" — $4,000 / year invoiced annually on anniversary. First year includes one complimentary ad-hoc evidence export; any additional exports billed at $1,200 each.

• HSM onboarding: "WellPath — HSM Onboarding" — One-time invoice $30,000. Apply $5,000 credit distributed as $833.33 against months 1–6 of the residency monthly invoice. 

I’ve attached a clean quote and a DocuSign request (DS link) for signature. Once signed, finance will issue the PO and we’ll kick off onboarding.

Thanks — looking forward to getting WellPath live.

Best,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
